content: Heavy! That was your first impression with these ingots.
You were wondering if you could even lift tools made with these ingots. Unnecessary fears really.
Your Earth Elemetal Pickaxe might be a bit heavier than a regular pickaxe, it's performance and extra durability make it well worth the effort.
Instead of the usual 1 block, your Earth Pickaxe mines a 3x3 area all at once. This is going to be a great help when mining.
There even is a small on/off button to make it behave like a regular pickaxe, in case you want single blocks.
